name: Corporate Action General Information SD 55
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action general information details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

EventGroup.name: Event Group
EventGroup.definition: DTC processing domain/ category for event types.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) native corporate action event type name. Used in place for the events that cannot be classified by ISO code and mapped to OTHR or when two or more distinct events (in DTCC model) use same ISO code and there are no additional data elements that distinguish those two or more events.

SubEventType.name: Sub Event Type
SubEventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) native corporate action sub event type name further defines the event type.

InstructionMessagingEligibilityFlag.name: Instruction Messaging Eligibility Flag
InstructionMessagingEligibilityFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event is eligible for Elective Dividend Services instruction messaging or voluntary reorganization instruction messaging.

RedemptionIdentification.name: Redemption Identification
RedemptionIdentification.definition: Unique number systemically assigned to all lottery and non-lottery events announced in DTC redemptions (REDS) participant terminal system (PTS)/ participant browser system(PBS) function.

DTCFCPElectionFlag.name: DTCFCP Election Flag
DTCFCPElectionFlag.definition: Identifies events that offer instruction processing specific to foreign currency payment (FCP) elections.

AssetServicerProcessingFlag.name: Asset Servicer Processing Flag
AssetServicerProcessingFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event is being processed by DTC.

EDSMessagingEligibilityRule.definition: Applies only to distribution events that may be eligible for EDS ISO 20022 messaging services. It will not be present for Redemption or Reorganisation events.
